name: circuit_count
candidate_meaning: expected circuit count (a supported capacity, not an installed count); circuit indexes 0..8 used by a requester

name: zone_count
candidate_meaning: expected zone count (a supported capacity, not an installed count); zone indexes 0..8 used by a requester

name: heat_pump_count
candidate_meaning: heat pump count (candidate); competing candidate: a reply above 1.0 means that no supported heat pump is available; which reading applies to which controllers is unresolved

name: recovair_count
candidate_meaning: ventilation present when the value is 1 (VRC720 family; candidate); the value does not prove GG10h or device presence
